name: España

geography.notes: Use versioned INE municipality codes as strings, province and autonomous community context, plus locality aliases and rural population nuclei. Explicit strata: peninsular rural municipalities, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla; retain cross-border market claims separately from POS address. Municipality is not postcode; do not infer Spain from .es or Spanish.

strategies.notes: Review notices for new legal names and changes; link observed legal-entity candidates with evidence. Corporate object does not establish live sales, a POS or stock. Missing sole traders require independent channels.

Plan each official municipality, including islands and small settlements; evaluate admitted local OSM extracts for shop=car, motorcycle and relevant repair/retail POIs. No public Nominatim sweep. Workshop and wrecking-yard leads need evidence of whole vehicles for sale.

Follow public association member links after per-surface admission; separate rental-only firms, caravan-only businesses and motorhome sellers. Nonmembers and home-based converters remain an explicit gap.
Visible restricted channel. Affiliate utilities are not assumed public or free. Public provincial association links may be researched independently; do not sign up or purchase.

Use the explicit provincial list to discover branches including islands, then classify their owned sites. One brand is a starting network, not the full market; independent and other-brand dealers require their own channels.
Blocked research fetch remains visible. If permitted review succeeds, preserve source, publisher and possible seller separately; never infer POS solely from a publisher account.
Motorcycle-specific route retained despite 403. No anti-bot bypass, automated campaign or inventory proof.
Rotate locality and regional-language terms, include industrial estates and small repair shops with sales. Directory hits are leads; no minimum stock, ratings or review-count threshold.

Authored search recipes for independent dealer websites; Common Crawl is only a historical URL cross-check of candidate domains, not a full-text query API. Include .com and hosted subpaths; lexical/TLD signals do not prove market country.
Public professional-page referrals can reveal tiny web-less sellers. Manually review admissible business signals only; login walls stay blocked and private profiles are not dealer censuses.

sources.title: INE: relación de municipios y sus códigos por provincias
sources.access_notes: Official territorial reference, including intrayear changes; geography does not enumerate sellers.

sources.title: BOE: Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil
sources.access_notes: Public official business notices, useful for names and changes; not a complete establishment or sole-trader directory. Review reuse and personal-data fields.

sources.title: ASEICAR: association and members listing entry
sources.access_notes: Public association entry links member discovery; membership is partial and does not prove motorised stock. No membership or private area purchased.

sources.title: GANVAM: affiliate utilities
sources.access_notes: Affiliate services are not a free open bulk directory; keep as permission-required route without paid access.

sources.title: SEAT: provincial dealer list
sources.access_notes: Official brand directory explicitly names island and rural outlets; dealership/service distinction and stock require further evidence.

sources.title: coches.net: dealer directory lead
sources.access_notes: Research request returned HTTP 405; path is a lead with access unverified, not an executable or admitted connector.

sources.title: motos.net: motorcycle portal lead
sources.access_notes: Research request returned HTTP 403; retain visible for manual access assessment, never bypass the block.

sources.title: Páginas Amarillas: local business directory
sources.access_notes: Public locality/category search exists. Extraction/reuse permission is unverified; paid placements, stale rows and service-only workshops cause bias.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap copyright and licence
sources.access_notes: ODbL and attribution obligations must be assessed before use of a dated local extract; no country completeness claim.

sources.title: OSMF public Nominatim usage policy
sources.access_notes: Public Nominatim forbids systematic locality/grid/all-POI queries. It is not an exhaustive discovery backend.

sources.title: Common Crawl URL index
sources.access_notes: Free URL archive index, not full-text search. Bound exact-domain lookups; bulk filtering belongs on local index data with resource budget. Archive results are historical leads.

sources.title: Meta explanation of automated collection restrictions
sources.access_notes: Prior permission is required for automated collection. This channel is manual public business-page lead review only, without account creation or login bypass.

blind_spots: Rural nuclei and industrial estates can share municipality names while hosting different POS; absent online listings do not mean no business.
Canary/Balearic islands and Ceuta/Melilla require explicit locality lists and independent access checks, not extrapolation from mainland results.
Basque, Catalan/Valencian and Galician spelling variants need reviewed aliases; vocabulary here is an authored query set, not a complete linguistic lexicon.
Association membership and manufacturer networks omit independents; public registries omit some business forms and do not prove digital inventory.
Tiny sellers with one vehicle or unknown stock remain in scope; dealerships, workshops and dismantlers need whole-vehicle evidence.
No channel, seed URL or access_mode constitutes permission or coverage certification; query saturation is not a denominator.
